_meta.teamKey: teams.NFL and teams.NCAAF are each keyed by ESPN team id. The same numeric id is a different club in each league.
_meta.roof: dome | retractable | open. Retractable is treated as closed unless knownOpen is true. Default is closed, so the total adjustment is 0.
_meta.bounds: Team pins must sit in the continental US (lat 24.4..49.5, lon -125..-66.5) or Hawaii (lat 18.8..22.3, lon -160.5..-154.5).
_meta.coordinates: NFL pins are Google Earth stadium coordinates (greerreNFL / nflverse stadium table). FBS pins are sportsdataverse cfb_teams_2026 latitude/longitude, checked against the geocoded FBS stadium list. Overrides: UAB Protective Stadium (the feed pin was downtown Birmingham); Northwestern Ryan Field (stadium pin, venue 11823); UNLV Allegiant (venue 6501); Illinois Memorial Stadium in Champaign (the core venue label pointed at Lexington, VA); Baylor McLane; Houston TDECU; Colorado State Canvas; Hawaii Ching Complex; San Diego State Snapdragon. SoFi (venue 7065) is a fixed roof and is classified dome. NRG, AT&T, Mercedes-Benz, State Farm, and Lucas Oil are retractable.
_meta.neutral: venues.NFL and venues.NCAAF are keyed by ESPN competition venue id. Venue ids are not unique across leagues. Cotton Bowl is NCAAF/NFL 499. Tottenham Hotspur Stadium is NFL 5534 and is outside NWS coverage.
